Select compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles for compounds tested against the human adenosine A2a receptor. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to match the target. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Filter by target_dictionary.pref_name matching 'adenosine A2a receptor' and organism 'Homo sapiens'. Sort by compound_chembl_id. Do not deduplicate.
